subject: Science
unitTitle: Living Organisms, Their Structure and Processes
source: El-Moasser Science Main Book 2027 + Assessments + Final Revision + Final Exams

questions.text: Microscopic living organisms that may be beneficial or harmful are called ______.
questions.answer: microbes

questions.text: Specialized structures on roots of legumes that contain beneficial bacteria are root ______.
questions.answer: nodules

questions.text: Give a reason: Root nodule bacteria are important for leguminous plants.
questions.answer: They convert nitrogen into nitrogenous compounds useful for plant growth.

questions.text: Give a reason: Decomposition bacteria increase soil fertility.
questions.answer: They decompose dead legume roots into soluble nitrogenous compounds and recycle necessary elements.

questions.text: Which microbe is used in yogurt production?
questions.answer: Lactic acid bacteria

questions.text: Which fungus is used in Roquefort cheese production?
questions.answer: Penicillium roqueforti

questions.text: Penicillin is extracted from:
questions.answer: Penicillium notatum

questions.text: Give a reason: Yeast fungus is useful to humans.
questions.answer: It is used in bread and ethyl alcohol production, is a source of vitamin B complex, and is rich in antioxidants.

questions.text: What happens if yogurt is not refrigerated after preparation?
questions.answer: Lactic acid bacteria continue their action, producing more lactic acid and increasing acidity.

questions.text: What happens if food is left uncovered?
questions.answer: It may become contaminated with harmful microbes such as Salmonella typhi or Entamoeba histolytica.

questions.text: What may happen if a person eats food contaminated with Salmonella typhi?
questions.answer: The person may develop typhoid disease.

questions.text: What may happen if a person eats food contaminated with Entamoeba histolytica?
questions.answer: The person may develop amoebic dysentery.

questions.text: Compare amoebic dysentery and typhoid disease in the causative microbe.
questions.answer: Amoebic dysentery is caused by Entamoeba histolytica, a unicellular eukaryotic protozoan parasite; typhoid is caused by Salmonella typhi, a prokaryotic bacterium.

questions.text: Compare the usual habitat of Entamoeba histolytica and Salmonella typhi in a patient.
questions.answer: Entamoeba histolytica lives mainly in the large intestine; Salmonella typhi affects the digestive tract.

questions.text: Which is a beneficial prokaryotic microbe?
questions.answer: Root nodule bacteria

questions.text: Which is a beneficial eukaryotic microbe?
questions.answer: Yeast fungus

questions.text: Give a reason: Farmers may leave roots of leguminous plants in the soil after harvesting.
questions.answer: Decomposition can convert them into soluble nitrogenous compounds, increasing soil fertility and recycling elements.

questions.text: Give a reason: A spoonful of previously prepared yogurt is added to milk when making yogurt.
questions.answer: It supplies lactic acid bacteria that convert lactose into lactic acid.

questions.text: Give a reason: A little sugar may be added to salt solution when making pickles.
questions.answer: Sugar can act as food for beneficial lactic acid bacteria, improving taste and preservation.

questions.text: Give a reason: Teeth should be brushed with a personal toothbrush after meals.
questions.answer: To reduce bacteria accumulated in the mouth and help prevent disease and bad breath.

questions.text: The scientist associated with discovering penicillin is Alexander ______.
questions.answer: Fleming

questions.text: List three ways harmful microbes may enter the human body.
questions.answer: By breathing, by ingesting contaminated food, and by penetrating skin and reaching the bloodstream.

questions.text: All bacteria are harmful microbes.
questions.answer: False

questions.text: Consultant-generated application: A student classifies all fungi as harmful. Correct the classification using two lesson examples.
questions.answer: The idea is wrong: Penicillium roqueforti and yeast are useful fungi; some fungi can be harmful, but not all fungi are harmful.
